ledger-sales-total.title: CSV ledger aggregation pattern
ledger-sales-total.content: Task pattern: "total amount of sales rows in ledger.csv export". Steps: read export.json first — it holds parser params (keys: encoding, delimiter, preamble_lines, file). ledger.csv columns = category,amount; rows alternate sales/refund. "total amount of sales rows" = SUM(amount) over category=="sales" (a sum, not a row count). Use parse_csv with encoding/delimiter/skip_lines from export.json. read_file returns only a hex prefix for these files; parse_csv gives full rows. Always emit {"answer": number}. Observed variants: amounts scale (e.g. 11/29/47/65 -> 152; earlier run 10/28/46/64 -> 148), so always recompute rather than reusing a remembered total.

experience-tool-quirks.title: experience tool usage quirks
experience-tool-quirks.content: experience `put` requires a non-empty `id` string; omitting it fails with {"error":"KeyError: 'id'"} even though the schema lists id as optional. Always pass op,id,title,content. Reusing an existing id fully replaces (bumps version). Use op:"search" (query, or empty) to list entries, op:"get" with id to read one, op:"delete" with id to remove.
